title: Chapter 464
text:
Those red tentacles seemed to belong to a certain monster. It seemed like Herlous had been thrown somewhere. If they wanted to bring him back, they could only start with this Teleportation Mage.

Teleportation magic was quite powerful, but there were many restrictions for players to use it. The learning requirement was very high, and most teleportation magic could only be used when not in battle or needed to be guided. It could not be interrupted midway. Basically, it could only be used as a hurried skill.

"There are strong people everywhere. Noriose is really scary." Sylvia swallowed nervously.

"Should we attack?" The second Volga brother said seriously. "There are so many people here. If we fight, the security team will intervene very quickly. I can sense that his teleportation magic is activated at any time. Before we move, he will leave. Also, we definitely can't follow him through the light gate. If he closes it midway, we will be cut in half."

Yi Xuan interrupted. "Your partner is right, so hurry up and leave my —"

Before he finished speaking, Han Xiao did not say anything else. In the blink of an eye, his mecha was attached to him and he rushed out like a flash of lightning.

"You really don't understand human language. You still don't want to give up and ambush me? I saw through your plan long ago. All of you are so rude! "

Yi Xuan did not panic at all. He sneered and activated the teleportation magic that was already on standby. The light gate appeared behind him instantly, and he retreated in a flash.

At this time, the mecha warrior who wanted to ambush him was still some distance away. With his spellcasting speed, he could close the teleportation door long before the opponent got close.

Right at this moment!

A large hand suddenly appeared in front of him as if it had appeared out of thin air. Before Yi Xuan could react, the hand had passed through the teleportation door and grabbed his face.

The hand covered his eyes, and Yi Xuan could not see anything. At this moment, he finally panicked.

What happened?!

The next moment, a strong force came from the hand. Han Xiao, who had turned into a void, pulled Yi Xuan out of the teleportation door!

It was because his body had crossed the light gate again that Yi Xuan could only hurriedly stop the closing spell that he had prepared. Otherwise, he would be the one cut in half!

Thus, the situation was reversed in an instant!

With a flash of Mechanical Force, the Void Dragon mechanical suit behind him, which had already become an empty shell, split into many parts, and with the guidance of Mechanical Force, it once again attached itself to Han Xiao's body.

He suddenly swung with force, and Yi Xuan was thrown out like a cannonball, smashing an entire row of bookshelves along the way. Torn papers flew everywhere, and wood shavings flew everywhere!

Bang!!

Yi Xuan slammed his head into the wall, creating a hole. His head was bruised and bleeding, and before he could recover from the dizziness, he felt a heavy weight on his body.

Like a shadow, Han Xiao flashed to his side and pinned his hands behind his back. Using his knees, Han Xiao pressed his face to the ground with his other hand, directly subduing him and making him unable to move!

A terrifying energy gathered on the mecha's arm, as if it was about to erupt at any moment. At this moment, Han Xiao's mocking voice rang in Yi Xuan's ears.

"What did you just say? Say it again. "

Blood trickled down from his forehead, drenching his hair. Yi Xuan's eyes were wide open. Thick shock congealed in his eyes, and his face was filled with disbelief.

He did not expect that his life-saving method, which had always worked, would fail!

Of course, Han Xiao was using his racial talent, [Void Travel].

In the almost still Void Vision, everyone's movements were stopped. No matter what escape method Yi Xuan had, it was all meaningless. He easily approached this Teleportation Mage, then deactivated Void Vision, returned to reality, and directly crossed the distance to capture his opponent. In the eyes of outsiders, Han Xiao had clearly appeared in front of Yi Xuan out of thin air.

"You, how did you …"

Han Xiao increased the force in his hand and coldly said, "Release my partner. Don't play any tricks, unless you want to let your brain matter smear all over your bookstore."

"I, I admit defeat. Don't go overboard!" Yi Xuan hurriedly did as he was told. His life was in someone else's hands, and he did not dare to act recklessly. A few meters away, a circle of teleportation light slowly appeared.

…

Rewind time to fifteen seconds ago.

Buzz!

In the crimson sky, a light door suddenly appeared. Countless crimson tentacles shot into the sky and surged into the light door. The next moment, Herlous was pulled in.

In a hurry, he used his arms to push away the tentacles wrapped around him, took out the Battleship Slicing Blade from his back, and slashed around his body. All the tentacles were cut in half. However, there was nothing under his feet, and he fell down. He was about thirty meters from the ground. The ground was dark red.

Bang!

Herlous landed on the ground with a dull thud.

Looking up, the teleportation door had already disappeared.

"I actually fell into a trap. This is bad. I can't go back myself." Herlous was frustrated and frustrated. He looked around. "What is this place? What were those tentacles just now …"

He looked around. There was a flat red ground nearby. There were no creatures, only black holes in the ground.

Herlous' expression changed, and he jumped up.

Bang, bang, bang!

The next moment, a large number of tentacles broke out of the ground where he was standing. There were hundreds of them, and they went straight for him. The wind howled, and a terrifying wind pressure was created.

"These tentacles all seem to belong to a creature hidden underground. Just how big is this monster?" Herlous' forehead was covered in sweat. Just as he was about to attack again, a red stream of light suddenly appeared at the edge of his vision.

Swoosh!

This red stream of light swept past all the tentacles, and the hundreds of tentacles all stopped. Just as the red light swept past, all the tentacles had smooth cuts at the same time. They were all cut in half. The cut ends all fell to the ground, and the roots of the tentacles all retracted back into the ground.

The red light circled around and floated in front of Herlous, revealing its true appearance.

"It's you!" Herlous was shocked.

"Hmm, I've seen you before." The other party clearly knew Herlous, and he was shocked.

Before he could ask, the sound of spells came from the sky, and the teleportation door appeared again.

"Ha, looks like the captain has already taken care of that Teleportation Mage. How efficient."

Herlous' eyes sparkled, and he laughed out loud. He trusted Han Xiao a lot. After being thrown here, he believed that Han Xiao would be able to bring him back very quickly.

As expected, that Teleportation Mage's little trick was nothing in front of the captain. It did not even last a minute.

"Great, I can finally get out!" The other person was also surprised.

…

In the bookstore, the teleportation door was opened steadily. Everyone stared at the light door. Not long after, Herlous flew out. Not only him, there was another person following him out of the light door.

"There's someone else inside!" Sylvia exclaimed. "Who are you?"

Han Xiao looked over in confusion and was stunned.

"Wilsander?"

This person was the captain of the Floating Dragon Island guards, Wilsander!

"Yo, long time no see." Wilsander was still skinny and wretched, waving his hand in greeting.

"Why are you here?" Han Xiao was surprised. "And you came out of the teleportation door?"

Wilsander coughed, pointed at Herlous, and said, "I went in the same way he went in."

Han Technician's mouth twitched, and he suddenly understood.

So that was the case. Other than himself, Ames had also sent Wilsander to look for her teacher. Then, Wilsander was also tricked by the Dragon Emperor's teacher. When he found Yi Xuan, he encountered the same problem as them. Wilsander, who used to be a great galactic pirate, did things by force. Thus, he was naturally thrown to another place by this teleportation mage.

It was a small world indeed. Han Xiao did not expect to meet Wilsander here. He asked, "When did you arrive?"

"A few days ago, not much earlier than you."

Wilsander looked at Yi Xuan, who was being pressed down by Han Xiao, and anger appeared on his face. He walked over angrily, and the wings behind him suddenly spread open. The edges of the wings lit up with a bright red light, and murderous aura filled the air. He yelled, "How dare you trick me! I'll kill you! "

The wings slashed down, and Han Xiao hurriedly reached out and grabbed Wilsander's demon bat wings firmly.

"Don't be rash. Noriose can't kill people casually. We still have to dig out clues about the Dragon Emperor's teacher from him."

"… Okay." Wilsander felt that it made sense, so he retracted his wings and backed away. Suddenly, he realized that something was wrong. His expression changed, and he turned around abruptly, looking at Han Xiao's back in shock.

With his Grade B + strength, how could Han Xiao block his attack so easily?

When he first met Black Star, he was far from having this kind of strength!

Ignoring the secretly shocked Wilsander, Han Xiao yelled at Yi Xuan, "Tell me, where did you teleport my target?"

Yi Xuan said with a trembling voice, "I — I don't know."

"Wow, you have guts and courage. Looks like you're not afraid of death!" Herlous clenched his fists, and the sound of his bones cracking could be heard. He had an eager expression on his face. "I haven't settled the score with you yet."

"No, it's not like that. You misunderstood." Yi Xuan had a long face. "I really don't know. He asked me to use a random teleportation gate, and the coordinates were on the surface of Noriose. Because the location was random, I don't know where he went."

Han Xiao frowned, turned around, and said, "Fu Ding, do me a favor."

Fu Ding nodded, walked forward, and pointed at Yi Xuan's forehead. Psychic tentacles entered Yi Xuan's brain and made the teleportation mage repeat what he said. Then, Fu Ding closed his eyes and opened them after a while. He shook his head and said, "He's not lying. It's true. He really doesn't know where the target is."

Everyone looked at each other with a depressed expression. They thought that they finally had the upper hand this time, but the clue was cut off here again.

Sylvia bit her lips and said angrily, "I know. This is his plan. Even if we succeed in getting the location out of him, we still won't get anything. He purposely used a random teleportation gate to make us feel emotional. He's playing with us! This person is so annoying! "

Wilsander wagged his tail in frustration. "Can we only steal the Heart of Crystal Fire according to his request? This is the only clue we have."

Han Xiao frowned, and a light suddenly flashed in his eyes. He quickly suppressed his laughter and said with a serious face, "I don't care about his request. If that's the case, then don't look for him. Anyway, this is enough."

"Are we going to give up?" Herlous clenched his teeth, feeling a little unwilling. He really wanted to catch this diviner and beat him up!

"We don't have to be led by the nose by the target. Ames will be here soon. As long as we tell her about this clue, our job will be considered complete."

Han Xiao stood up, clapped his hands, and took out a healing potion. He tossed it to Yi Xuan and turned to leave.

"You … you're just going to let it go?" Yi Xuan got up with a surprised tone. He thought that he would not be able to avoid physical pain.

Herlous also interrupted, "Yeah, why don't we teach him a lesson? I suffered a great loss."

Han Xiao rolled his eyes and said, "Forget it. At least he didn't throw you into outer space. He didn't want to kill you, so this saved his life."

Then, Han Technician turned around and looked at the mess on the ground. He raised his eyebrows and said, "But I won't pay for the repair fees."

"I didn't want to ask you for it." Yi Xuan smiled bitterly. He had no intention of provoking Han Xiao again. The other party had some kind of teleportation ability. No matter how fast his teleportation spell was, he would not be able to escape. He was only good at teleportation spells and knew almost nothing about offensive spells. His core ability was useless, so there was no point in fighting. He only wanted to wait for this group of people to leave quickly and never see them again.

…

The group left the weird bookstore. Wilsander was added to the team. This guy felt that rather than acting alone, he would rather team up with his colleagues.

On the way, Wilsander pulled Han Xiao aside and said with a nervous tone.

"Are we really not going to care about the target? Ames won't be angry, will she? "

"No need. The target must still be in Noriose. When Ames arrives, she can search the entire planet in minutes with her ability. So, we don't have to rush to find him. As soon as the Dragon Emperor arrives, he will have nowhere to hide."
